reason: The sole formal survivor, residual_variance_ratio, is mechanically non-increasing in r for every one of the 500 replication-origin (20 reps x 25 origins) trajectories checked, because FactorAdjustment removes nested top-r PCA subspaces and residual variance cannot increase as more components are removed, for any dataset. Its full-grid mean curve (0.770 at r=1 down to 0.238 at r=9) is smooth across the entire range with no optimum, elbow, or sign reversal at r_true=5 -- see results/figures/figure4_primary_observable_curves.png. It therefore cannot locate the correct factor count; it can only report how much variance was discarded.
what_would_change_this: A negative control confirming residual_variance_ratio is NOT similarly monotone under a DGP with no true low-rank factor structure (or a misspecified K_true), and/or a second independently pre-specified DGP setting showing the same classification, per execution-prompt section 13.
